categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in intelligent equipment manufacturing, focusing on the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of digital intelligent equipment and providing integrated solutions. Key product lines include intelligent conveying and batching equipment, green environmental protection equipment, intelligent digital display and storage equipment, silicon material recycling intelligent equipment, specialized intelligent equipment, waste tire pyrolysis resource recycling products, and 5G network equipment. The company also engages in software and information technology services related to these products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies such as 5G communication, industrial internet, artificial intelligence, and digital manufacturing. It has developed proprietary technologies including intelligent pyrolysis equipment for waste tires, polysilicon purification recycling technology for photovoltaic materials, and 5G-based industrial internet solutions. Production is mainly customized and project-driven, with a 'make-to-order' approach for non-standard equipment and assembly-based production for digital display and storage equipment. The company emphasizes continuous R&D, patent ownership, and participation in national standards formulation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers include enterprises in the rubber tire recycling industry, photovoltaic industry, petrochemical, mining, and smart manufacturing sectors. It serves domestic clients predominantly, with a small portion of sales overseas. Key customers are large industrial and governmental entities requiring intelligent manufacturing solutions, 5G communication equipment, and environmental recycling technologies. The company also collaborates with telecom operators and provides emergency communication devices to public security and firefighting units.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with headquarters and multiple subsidiaries located in Beijing, Tianjin, Jiangxi, Anhui, Shanghai, Ningxia, and other provinces. It has established service networks in Thailand, India, Indonesia, South Korea, and the Czech Republic to support overseas customers. The majority of sales and operations are domestic, with limited international sales primarily through trade companies or direct contracts.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and integration of intelligent equipment and digital solutions. It procures raw materials and components from suppliers but adds value through R&D, system integration, and customized manufacturing. It also provides after-sales services and technical support, positioning itself as a solution provider rather than a raw material supplier or end-user.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes intelligent manufacturing, digital transformation, and green recycling technologies aligned with national policies such as the '14th Five-Year Plan' and 'Dual Carbon' goals. R&D priorities include 5G industrial internet applications, AI integration, waste tire pyrolysis technology, polysilicon recycling, and smart factory solutions. The company invests heavily in innovation, patent development, and collaboration with academic institutions to maintain technological leadership and expand into data storage and computing services.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of customized intelligent equipment and integrated solutions, including project-based contracts. The company also employs direct sales and distribution channels for digital display and storage equipment. Additional revenue streams include after-sales services, technical consulting, and data-related services such as cloud and big data center operations. Government subsidies and tax incentives also contribute to financial performance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the intelligent equipment manufacturing sector, particularly in waste tire recycling and 5G industrial internet applications. It competes with domestic and international high-end equipment manufacturers and technology providers. Its competitive advantages stem from proprietary technologies, extensive patent portfolios, national standard-setting participation, and strong R&D capabilities. The company faces intensified competition due to industry growth attracting new entrants with strong brand, technology, and capital resources.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported total revenue of approximately 234 million RMB, representing a 58.76% decline year-over-year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about 202 million RMB. The decline was due to project implementation delays and prolonged receivables collection. The company has total assets of around 1.62 billion RMB and equity attributable to shareholders of approximately 616 million RMB. Despite recent financial challenges, the company continues to invest significantly in R&D, with expenditures around 54.9 million RMB, accounting for 23.47% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through advanced proprietary technologies, high customization capabilities, and integration of 5G and AI into intelligent manufacturing solutions. It offers environmentally friendly and energy-efficient equipment, such as continuous automated pyrolysis systems for waste tires and low-carbon polysilicon recycling technology. Its comprehensive after-sales service network and rapid response system enhance customer satisfaction. The company’s strategic alignment with national policies and its participation in industry standard-setting further strengthen its market credibility and competitive edge.
